SQL.scope: assert current source owner including generation/selection/privacy; exact businessDate/timeZone; current consumed day only
SQL.bounds: 101 jobs/101 prior maturity receipts; truncation and existing-receipt coverage explicit; no whole-tenant scans or raw payload returned
SQL.ACL: both new functions owner-only, PUBLIC/runtime/coordinator/source roles receive no grant
SQL.unknown_operation: never read/settle ambiguous pending operation or free its reservation

metrics.process: monotonic elapsed, processCPU delta, endpointRSS shared-process not per-job CPU or peakRSS
metrics.counter_coverage: instrumented calls only; SQL budget explicitly reserved not actual
metrics.money: unknown; approved rates/full coverage and EO06 calculation separate
metrics.reconciliation: existing validated maturity receipts and complete expected-date manifest required; missing/truncated unknown

alarms.classes: existing AL01-AL16 stage/severity; existing guard failures enter as trusted classified signal
alarms.queue_silence: elapsed strictly greater than120000ms, no extra grace/startup reset; duplicate/future/foreign signal rejected
alarms.stage_limits: explicit approved per-stage milliseconds, no universal120s default
alarms.manifest: complete expected eligible scope refs; one healthy scope cannot mask missing/stale scope
alarms.independent_witness: load existing independent durable state then single CAS; primaryDB failure still evaluates stored heartbeat; CAS unknown stops no retry
alarms.dedup: env+generation+opaque scope+reason/stage; first/last/count; repeats retain notification state and expiry
alarms.expiry: explicit expiry input required; live storage requires approved class/owner/expiry/deletion adapter; no default forever
alarms.recovery: verified evidence plus authorized resolution; no business retry/checkpoint/release

activation_holds: independent deployed observer/store/witness and accepted failure domains
verification: unit/real F01 rollback SQL with synthetic owners/pages/keys; no real notification delivery or live independence acceptance
